node.statement: Remark 7.1: The 1/p⁴ poles correspond to a double pole at p²=0, splitting into a massless graviton and a massless Weyl ghost in the Hamiltonian decomposition. The 1/k⁴ piece in ⟨ΦΦ⟩ is instantaneous (no ω-dependence) — the fourth-derivative analogue of the Newtonian potential constraint.
